name: All-Weather Portfolio
description: Stocks, long and intermediate Treasuries, gold and commodities in fixed weights, rebalanced monthly.

versions.config_sexpr:
(strategy "All-Weather Portfolio"
  :rebalance monthly
  :benchmark SPY
  (weight :method specified
    (asset VTI :weight 30)
    (asset TLT :weight 40)
    (asset IEF :weight 15)
    (asset GLD :weight 7.5)
    (asset DBC :weight 7.5)))

name: Recession Radar
description: Holds TLT 60% and GLD 40% while SPY's 14-day RSI is above the threshold, otherwise VTI, QQQ and IWM in equal weights.

versions.config_sexpr:
(strategy "Recession Radar"
  :rebalance daily
  :benchmark SPY
  (if (> (rsi SPY 14) 75)
    (group "Defensive"
      (weight :method specified
        (asset TLT :weight 60)
        (asset GLD :weight 40)))
    (else
      (group "Risk on"
        (weight :method equal
          (asset VTI)
          (asset QQQ))))))

name: Momentum Sectors
description: Holds the three sector ETFs with the strongest 90-day momentum in equal weights, rebalanced weekly.

versions.config_sexpr:
(strategy "Momentum Sectors"
  :rebalance monthly
  :benchmark SPY
  (filter :by momentum :select (top 2) :lookback 60
    (weight :method equal
      (asset XLK)
      (asset XLC)
      (asset XLY)
      (asset XLF)
      (asset XLI)
      (asset XLE)
      (asset XLB)

name: Risk Parity
description: SPY, TLT, GLD and DBC weighted by inverse 60-day volatility, rebalanced monthly.

versions.config_sexpr:
(strategy "Risk Parity"
  :rebalance monthly
  :benchmark SPY
  (weight :method inverse-volatility :lookback 60
    (asset SPY)
    (asset TLT)
    (asset GLD)
    (asset DBC)))

name: Dual Momentum
description: Holds the stronger of SPY and EFA while SPY's trailing return is positive, otherwise BND.

versions.changelog: Created from the Dual Momentum template
versions.config_sexpr:
(strategy "Dual Momentum"
  :rebalance monthly
  :benchmark SPY
  (if (> (return SPY 252) 0)
    (filter :by momentum :select (top 1) :lookback 252
      (weight :method equal
        (asset SPY)
        (asset EFA)))
    (else
      (asset BND))))

name: Pullback Buyer
description: Buys SPY when its 5-day RSI falls under 25 and parks in BIL otherwise. Drafted with Copilot.

versions.config_sexpr:
(strategy "Pullback Buyer"
  :rebalance daily
  :benchmark SPY
  (if (< (rsi SPY 5) 25)
    (asset SPY)
    (else
      (asset BIL))))
